body: A fast, local neural text to speech system
plain_description: Piper turns text into speech locally on your own machine — no cloud, no data leaving your system. It runs fast on consumer hardware and costs nothing per use. The bottom line: private, offline neural TTS with no ongoing fees.
technical_description: Piper is a neural text-to-speech inference engine written in C++ that runs entirely on local hardware without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for CPU execution and a Docker image is available for deployment. Development of this repository has moved to the OHF-Voice organization.
title: Piper
